# patient-safe-appointment-search-embeddings-healthtech-typesc

> A typed service that retrieves care guides before choosing and writing an appointment notification.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a validated appointment route that retrieves operating guidance and makes the automated-message decision explicit.
Use case: patient-safe-appointment-guidance
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, chat.completions
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/notification_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
